issues.description: Exercise 7 expects students to implement a forward-QFT entrypoint named `qft_circuit_n_qubits`, but the template defines the method as `_qft_circuit_n_qubits` (leading underscore). The reference solution implements `qft_circuit_n_qubits` without the underscore. This name mismatch can cause learners to implement the wrong method name and fail tests that call `qft_circuit_n_qubits`.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the template method `_qft_circuit_n_qubits` to `qft_circuit_n_qubits` (or add a public `qft_circuit_n_qubits` wrapper that calls the underscored method) so the template matches the problem statement and the reference solution.

issues.description: Exercise 7.2 hint says to reuse the circuit from “Exercise 2.1”, but Exercise 2 in the lab is Grover’s algorithm; the forward QFT implementation is Exercise 7.1 (and the earlier fixed-size QFT is Exercise 6.1). This incorrect cross-reference can confuse students about which prior QFT function to reuse.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the Exercise 7.2 hint to reference the correct prior QFT task (e.g., “Exercise 7.1”) instead of “Exercise 2.1”.
